title: Exact-Z/Q Algebraic Verification-vs-Computation Equivalence, Border-Rank Witness Certificates, and Derandomized Matrix Product Complexity
abstract: Inspired by Xiangle Chen's proof (arXiv:2611.34814v1, Nov. 2026) that deterministic exact real arithmetic verification of AB=C requires Omega(n^{omega_C}) operations via a decision-tree-to-border-rank reduction, we build a machine-checked, zero-float certification suite (MATVER-BORDERRANK-CERT-1.0) with 20 constructive Lean 4.36.0 theorems (0 sorry, 0 Classical.choice, -DwarningAsError=true), an AST-audited pure-Z/Q verifier, 16 SHA-256 certificates (C01-C16), and 66 adversarial tests. We certify: (i) Strassen's 7-product <2,2,2> tensor across all 64 entries over Z together with 7^100 < 2^281 certifying omega < 2.81; (ii) exact Z[eps] border-rank witnesses separating border rank from exact tensor rank for dual-number multiplication (R_border=2 < R=3) and Schonhage's direct-sum family at m=3 (R_border<=10 < 13) and m=4 (R_border<=17 < 25), paired with pure-integer tau-theorem proofs certifying omega < 2.70 and omega < 2.55 without floating-point logarithms; (iii) exact decision-tree cost lower bounds separating unconditional Omega(n^{omega_C}) from the cited conditional omega_C=9/4 hypothesis (n^{9/4}/n^2 = 2^k at n=2^{4k}); and (iv) Freivalds error ceilings (2^-30 < 10^-9, 16^-10 < 10^-12) contrasted with exact-Q Vandermonde nullspace witnesses proving every r<n deterministic linear probe matrix admits nonzero rank-1 error E with ER=0.
